# The Decentralized Compute Company

Official domain: https://decentralizedcompute.company/

TDCC connects AI companies with data centers and GPUs for training, fine-tuning, and inference.

## Core product
- One API for AI training, fine-tuning, inference, and evaluation.
- Routing to data centers and compatible GPU hosts.
- Verified results and payouts for accepted work.

## Initial workloads
- Training
- Fine-tuning
- Batch inference
- Image generation
- Audio transcription
- Embeddings
- Evaluations
- Synthetic data
- Agent workloads
- LoRA / QLoRA fine-tuning
- Open-model hosting
- Adapter serving

## Differentiation
TDCC sells verified AI work, not raw GPU hours.

## The TDCC App
The product surface of the network: a web console, a CLI, Python and TypeScript SDKs, and a REST job API.
Submit a job with constraints, the router matches hardware, execution runs in an approved isolated runtime,
results are verified against acceptance criteria, and only accepted work is billed and paid out.
Version 1.0 ships in staged early-access cohorts with the pilot network.

## Mission
AI infrastructure should be open, verifiable, and broadly owned.
